source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Write down the date and time of the test.
3. Record the model and serial number of the appliance.
4. Note down any unique identification labels or codes associated with the appliance.
5. Document the location where the appliance was tested.

6. State the specific safety standards that the appliance failed to meet.
7. List the parts/components of the appliance that were tested.

8. Describe the tests performed (e.g., earth continuity, insulation resistance, polarity, etc.).
9. Record detailed test results including numerical data where applicable.
10. Note any visible damage, wear, or irregularities observed during testing.

11. Attach photographs of the appliance and any relevant damages/deficiencies.
12. Document any actions taken or recommendations given for rectifying the issues identified.
13. Record the outcome of retesting if conducted (Pass/Fail).
14. Enter the name, signature, and qualifications of the person conducting the test.
15. Save or print
